pages.title: Cores and Structures
pages.text: A machine is a $(item)core$() block surrounded by a structure of ordinary blocks. Place the core, then build the structure shown on the machine's page around it.$(br2)When everything is right, the core $(thing)forms$() the machine: a wave runs through the blocks and turns them into its parts.

pages.title: Previews
pages.text: Every machine page has a 3D preview. Press $(thing)Visualize$(), then look at a placed core: the missing blocks appear as ghosts in the world, turned the way the core faces.$(br2)Machines with a front turn with their core, which faces you when placed, like a furnace.

pages.title: Using a Machine
pages.text: Right-click the core or any part to open the machine. Sneak to place blocks against it instead.$(br2)Hoppers, pipes and cables work on every part: items and fluids go in and out, energy goes in.

pages.title: Breaking
pages.text: $(4)Breaking any part breaks the whole machine$(): its parts vanish without drops. Only the core stays, with what it holds.$(br2)The $(item)Structure Builder$() places a core's whole structure at once.
Right-click a machine core: the structure is built from the blocks in your inventory. If anything is missing, it tells you what instead, and it never breaks blocks in the way. Free in creative.
